atoms.sound: Hey Mr Miller! How do you like being a teacher?
Oh, that’s a great question! I love being a teacher. I like teaching you guys and watching you learn new things. It makes me proud when my students do well.
Ahh, that’s nice! — Is there anything you don’t like about being a teacher?
Well, the school administration can make things difficult sometimes. And the pay is not great either.
You teach English and history, but are there other subjects you would like to teach?
Maybe... chemistry? But I didn’t study that at university, so I can’t teach it. I do love the subject though.
Interesting! Well, I’m going to go have my lunch now.
Bye Noor! — And don’t forget to hand in that essay next lesson!

atoms.text: Rhys wants to know more about the construction work going on nearby. He has a nice conversation with one of the workers.

b.sound: Hello. Sorry to bother you, but do you know when this construction work will be done?
Hey, shut up! Stop making so much noise!
Hi. We expect to complete it in two weeks.
Yes, I would love to help you. What do you need?
Okay, thanks for the information. What are you building here?
Thank you for the information. How is you building here?
We are repairing the roads and pavement. They are quite old.
We are firefighters. We are putting out fires.
I see. Is it difficult to repair them?
I see. Is it difficult to repair us?
It is routine work. We do it all the time and are used to it.
It is routine work. We does it all the times and be use to it.
That’s cool. What is it like being a construction worker?
That sounds bad. Should I call the police?
It is very hard work. We work long hours and for little pay.
It is very easy work. We sit at a desk in our office and relax all day.
I’m sorry to hear that. I won’t take up more of your time then. Goodbye.
That’s nice. I’m pleased to hear that.
